subject: Music Production
title: What Mixing Actually Means
description: A fast breakdown of What Mixing Actually Means for builders.

hook.text: A modern pop song can have over a hundred individual tracks that must be blended into one cohesive stereo mix.

buildup.text: Mixing adjusts the volume, panning, EQ, and effects of every track so they work together.

discovery.text: The goal is to make every instrument audible and balanced while serving the emotion of the song.

twist.text: A great mix can make a mediocre recording sound professional, while a bad mix ruins great performances.

climax.text: Mixing is where raw recordings are transformed into the polished music listeners hear every day.

punchline.text: A hundred tracks become one song through mixing.

quiz.question: What is the primary goal of mixing?
options: Making every track as loud as possible
Blending all tracks into a cohesive and balanced stereo mix
Adding new instruments to the recording
